نجتب (form VIII)
# نَجْتَبِ (najtabi) /nad͡ʒ.ta.bi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
# نُجْتَبَ (nujtaba) /nud͡ʒ.ta.ba/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِجْتَبَى (ijtabā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
